import math
def control(obs):
    h=obs['hitch_deg']
    cam=obs.get('views',{}).get('camera')
    steer=1.6*h
    if cam:
        sides=[[],[]]
        a=math.radians(-h)
        for b,d in cam.get('walls',[]):
            b=math.radians(b)
            x=d*math.cos(b); y=d*math.sin(b)
            s=-(x*math.cos(a)+y*math.sin(a))
            l=-x*math.sin(a)+y*math.cos(a)
            if s>0.4 and abs(l)>0.5:
                sides[0 if l>0 else 1].append((s,l))
        if all(len(p)>=2 for p in sides):
            vals=[]
            for p in sides:
                n=len(p); sx=sum(x for x,y in p); sy=sum(y for x,y in p)
                den=sum(x*x for x,y in p)-sx*sx/n
                m=(sum(x*y for x,y in p)-sx*sy/n)/max(0.1,den)
                vals.append(sy/n+m*(3.0-sx/n))
            mid=sum(vals)/2
            err=math.degrees(math.atan2(mid,3.0))
            steer=1.6*h-2.5*err
    return (max(-30,min(30,steer)),-0.65,-23)

args.code:
import math
bay=None
last=None
def control(obs):
 global bay,last
 t=obs['t']; dt=obs['dt']
 h=obs['hitch_deg']; a=math.radians(-h)
 if bay is not None and last is not None:
  v=obs['motion']['v_mps']; da=v/2.75*math.tan(math.radians(obs['steer_deg']))*(t-last)
  c=math.cos(da); s=math.sin(da); dx=v*(t-last)
  bay=[((x-dx)*c+y*s,-(x-dx)*s+y*c) for x,y in bay]
 last=t
 cam=obs.get('views',{}).get('camera')
 if bay is None and cam:
  p=[]
  for b,d in cam.get('target_corners',[]):
   b=math.radians(b); p.append((cam['origin'][0]+d*math.cos(b),cam['origin'][1]+d*math.sin(b)))
  if len(p)==3:
   pairs=sorted((math.hypot(p[i][0]-p[j][0],p[i][1]-p[j][1]),i,j) for i in range(3) for j in range(i))
   _,i,j=pairs[-1]; k=3-i-j
   fourth=(p[i][0]+p[j][0]-p[k][0],p[i][1]+p[j][1]-p[k][1])
   bay=p+[fourth]
 if bay is None: return (1.6*h,-0.3,-23)
 center=(sum(x for x,y in bay)/4,sum(y for x,y in bay)/4)
 edges=[]
 for p in bay[1:]:
  dx=p[0]-bay[0][0]; dy=p[1]-bay[0][1]
  edges.append((math.hypot(dx,dy),dx,dy))
 edges.sort()
 _,ux,uy=edges[1]; norm=math.hypot(ux,uy); ux/=norm; uy/=norm
 if ux>0: ux=-ux; uy=-uy
 rx,ry=obs['rig']['trailer_rear']
 along=(center[0]-rx)*ux+(center[1]-ry)*uy
 tx=center[0]+(2.0-along)*ux-rx; ty=center[1]+(2.0-along)*uy-ry
 forward=-(tx*math.cos(a)+ty*math.sin(a))
 lateral=-tx*math.sin(a)+ty*math.cos(a)
 err=math.degrees(math.atan2(lateral,max(0.5,forward)))
 steer=max(-30,min(30,1.6*h-2.2*err))
 return (steer,-0.4,-23)

p=(-8.4,-2.3)
u=(-0.984,-0.178)
last=None
def control(obs):
 global p,u,last
 t=obs['t']
 if last is not None:
  dt=t-last; v=obs['motion']['v_mps']; da=v/2.75*math.tan(math.radians(obs['steer_deg']))*dt
  c=math.cos(da); s=math.sin(da); x=p[0]-v*dt; y=p[1]
  p=(x*c+y*s,-x*s+y*c)
  u=(u[0]*c+u[1]*s,-u[0]*s+u[1]*c)
 last=t
 rx,ry=obs['rig']['trailer_rear']; h=obs['hitch_deg']; a=math.radians(-h)
 along=(p[0]-rx)*u[0]+(p[1]-ry)*u[1]
 tx=p[0]+(2.2-along)*u[0]-rx; ty=p[1]+(2.2-along)*u[1]-ry
 forward=-(tx*math.cos(a)+ty*math.sin(a)); lateral=-tx*math.sin(a)+ty*math.cos(a)
 err=math.degrees(math.atan2(lateral,max(0.5,forward)))
 steer=max(-32,min(32,1.8*h-1.8*err))
 return (steer,-0.3,-23)

import math
p=(-10.4,-1.88)
u=(-0.990,-0.138)
last=None
def control(obs):
 global p,u,last
 t=obs['t']
 if last is not None:
  dt=t-last; v=obs['motion']['v_mps']; da=v/2.75*math.tan(math.radians(obs['steer_deg']))*dt
  c=math.cos(da); s=math.sin(da); x=p[0]-v*dt; y=p[1]
  p=(x*c+y*s,-x*s+y*c)
  u=(u[0]*c+u[1]*s,-u[0]*s+u[1]*c)
 last=t
 rx,ry=obs['rig']['trailer_rear']; h=obs['hitch_deg']; a=math.radians(-h)
 along=(p[0]-rx)*u[0]+(p[1]-ry)*u[1]
 tx=p[0]+(3.0-along)*u[0]-rx; ty=p[1]+(3.0-along)*u[1]-ry
 forward=-(tx*math.cos(a)+ty*math.sin(a)); lateral=-tx*math.sin(a)+ty*math.cos(a)
 err=math.degrees(math.atan2(lateral,max(0.8,forward)))
 steer=max(-32,min(32,1.8*h-1.5*err))
 return (steer,-0.35,-23)

u=(-0.921,-0.390)
last=None
def control(obs):
 global p,u,last
 t=obs['t']
 if last is not None:
  dt=t-last; v=obs['motion']['v_mps']; da=v/2.75*math.tan(math.radians(obs['steer_deg']))*dt
  c=math.cos(da); s=math.sin(da); x=p[0]-v*dt; y=p[1]
  p=(x*c+y*s,-x*s+y*c)
  u=(u[0]*c+u[1]*s,-u[0]*s+u[1]*c)
 last=t
 rx,ry=obs['rig']['trailer_rear']; h=obs['hitch_deg']; a=math.radians(-h)
 along=(p[0]-rx)*u[0]+(p[1]-ry)*u[1]
 tx=p[0]+(3.0-along)*u[0]-rx; ty=p[1]+(3.0-along)*u[1]-ry
 forward=-(tx*math.cos(a)+ty*math.sin(a)); lateral=-tx*math.sin(a)+ty*math.cos(a)
 err=math.degrees(math.atan2(lateral,max(0.8,forward)))
 steer=max(-30,min(30,1.9*h-1.35*err))
 return (steer,-0.3,-23)

import math
pts=[]
X=Y=A=0.0
last=None
start=None
def control(o):
 global X,Y,A,last,start,pts
 t=o['t']; dt=o['dt']
 if start is None: start=t
 v=o['motion']['v_mps']; s=math.radians(o['steer_deg'])
 da=v*math.tan(s)/2.5*dt
 X+=v*math.cos(A+da/2)*dt; Y+=v*math.sin(A+da/2)*dt; A+=da
 ca=math.cos(A); sa=math.sin(A)
 for view in o['views'].values():
  ox,oy=view['origin']
  for b,d in view['walls']:
   b=math.radians(b); x=ox+d*math.cos(b); y=oy+d*math.sin(b)
   pts.append((X+ca*x-sa*y,Y+sa*x+ca*y,t))
 pts=[p for p in pts if t-p[2]<9]
 h=math.radians(o['hitch_deg']); ch=math.cos(h); sh=math.sin(h)
 rx,ry=o['rig']['trailer_rear']
 local=[]
 for px,py,pt in pts:
  dx=px-X; dy=py-Y
  x=ca*dx+sa*dy-rx; y=-sa*dx+ca*dy-ry
  u=ch*x-sh*y; w=sh*x+ch*y
  local.append((u,w))
 centers=[]
 for u0 in [-1,-3,-5]:
  ls=[w for u,w in local if abs(u-u0)<1.3 and 0.7<w<6]
  rs=[w for u,w in local if abs(u-u0)<1.3 and -6<w<-.7]
  if len(ls)>1 and len(rs)>1:
   ls.sort(); rs.sort(); centers.append((u0,(ls[len(ls)//2]+rs[len(rs)//2])/2))
 desired=0.0
 if centers:
  u,w=min(centers,key=lambda p:abs(p[0]+3))
  desired=max(-27,min(27,math.degrees(math.atan2(w,3.5))*1.7))
 steer=max(-40,min(40,.52*o['hitch_deg']+1.8*(o['hitch_deg']-desired)))
 look=-64.3 if int((t-start)/2.2)%2==0 else 64.3
 speed=-.65 if t-start>4.4 else 0
 if abs(o['hitch_deg'])>40: speed=0; wake('Large hitch angle; braking')
 if int(t*10)%50==0: print('track',centers,'desired',round(desired,1),'h',round(o['hitch_deg'],1))
 return steer,speed,look

  rs=[w for u,w in local if abs(u-u0)<1.3 and -6<w<-.7]
  if len(ls)>1 and len(rs)>1:

import math
X=Y=A=0.0
distance=0.0
def control(o):
 global X,Y,A,distance
 dt=o['dt']; v=o['motion']['v_mps']
 da=v*math.tan(math.radians(o['steer_deg']))/2.5*dt
 X+=v*math.cos(A+da/2)*dt; Y+=v*math.sin(A+da/2)*dt; A+=da
 distance+=max(0,-v)*dt
 rx,ry=o['rig']['trailer_rear']
 px=X+math.cos(A)*rx-math.sin(A)*ry
 py=Y+math.sin(A)*rx+math.cos(A)*ry
 angle=math.radians(-31)
 error=math.sin(-angle)*(px+3.9)+math.cos(angle)*(py-4.0)
 desired_heading=angle+math.atan2(error,2.8)
 trailer_heading=A-math.radians(o['hitch_deg'])
 delta=(trailer_heading-desired_heading+math.pi)%(2*math.pi)-math.pi
 desired=max(-35,min(42,math.degrees(delta)*1.7))
 h=o['hitch_deg']
 steer=max(-40,min(40,2.3*h-1.8*desired))
 if int(o['t']*10)%20==0: print('offset',round(error,2),'desired hitch',round(desired,1),'distance',round(distance,2))
 return (steer,-0.35 if distance<2.5 else 0,150)

import math
X=Y=A=distance=0.0
def control(o):
 global X,Y,A,distance
 dt=o['dt']; v=o['motion']['v_mps']
 da=v*math.tan(math.radians(o['steer_deg']))/2.5*dt
 X+=v*math.cos(A+da/2)*dt; Y+=v*math.sin(A+da/2)*dt; A+=da
 distance+=max(0,-v)*dt
 rx,ry=o['rig']['trailer_rear']
 px=X+math.cos(A)*rx-math.sin(A)*ry
 py=Y+math.sin(A)*rx+math.cos(A)*ry
 angle=math.radians(-21)
 error=-math.sin(angle)*(px+4.48)+math.cos(angle)*(py-4.99)
 desired_heading=angle+math.atan2(error,2.8)
 trailer_heading=A-math.radians(o['hitch_deg'])
 delta=(trailer_heading-desired_heading+math.pi)%(2*math.pi)-math.pi
 desired=max(-35,min(42,math.degrees(delta)*1.7))
 steer=max(-40,min(40,2.3*o['hitch_deg']-1.8*desired))
 if int(o['t']*10)%20==0: print('offset',round(error,2),'desired',round(desired,1),'distance',round(distance,2))
 return (steer,-0.3 if distance<1.6 else 0,150)

args.code:
import math
def clamp(x,a,b): return max(a,min(b,x))
def control(o):
    h=o['hitch_deg']; th=math.radians(-h)
    t=o.get('target',{})
    hd=0
    if t.get('in_sight') and 'bearing_deg' in t:
        b=math.radians(t['bearing_deg']); d=t['dist_m']
        eye=o['rig']['eye']; rear=o['rig']['trailer_rear']
        dx=eye[0]+d*math.cos(b)-rear[0]; dy=eye[1]+d*math.sin(b)-rear[1]
        u=-dx*math.cos(th)-dy*math.sin(th); y=-dx*math.sin(th)+dy*math.cos(th)
        hd=clamp(math.degrees(math.atan2(20.4*y,max(16,u*u+y*y))),-30,30)
    ff=math.degrees(math.atan(3.9/10.2*math.sin(math.radians(h))))
    return (clamp(ff+1.8*(h-hd),-42,42),-0.5,-41)
